site.title: Akshay Abraham — Student & Builder
site.description: Explore the projects, learning journey, and ideas of Akshay Abraham, a student and builder from Kottayam creating Lyra, Mitra, and MNEMO.

profile.name: Akshay Abraham
profile.summary: I’m a student and builder based in Kottayam, India — creating useful systems around learning and care. I listen to people, learn by making, and keep improving what I build.
intro: I’m Akshay Abraham (Akshay K Rooben Abraham), a student and builder from Kottayam. User empathy shapes how I work: understanding someone’s needs and thinking through the whole experience.

Lyra is my primary focus. It helps students work through problems and develop their reasoning. Alongside it, I’m building Mitra as a wearable companion and caretaker system and MNEMO as a voice-first knowledge companion for Obsidian.

experiences.description: Building Lyra as a guided learning system, Mitra as a wearable caretaker companion, and MNEMO as a voice-first knowledge companion. I share early versions, listen to people, and use that feedback to shape the work.

projects.name: Lyra
projects.description: An AI learning system that helps students work through problems and develop their reasoning. Built around guided learning, independent thinking, and feedback from students and educators.

projects.name: Mitra
projects.type: Wearable companion & care · With Chris V Jacob
projects.description: A wearable companion and caretaker system built around ESP32 devices, a home base, and a responsive caretaker app. Connects motion and location events, panic alerts, care routines, and a personal AI companion.

projects.name: MNEMO
projects.type: Voice & knowledge · With Chris V Jacob
projects.description: A voice-first knowledge companion for Obsidian. Turns recordings into organised, linked notes, with multilingual transcription, spoken recall, guided practice, and an offline recording queue.

projects.name: Driver Guard
projects.description: A local driver-monitoring dashboard built with Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, and FastAPI. Uses webcam-based eye and mouth tracking to detect fatigue signs and issue alerts, with optional ESP32 integration.

projects.name: M57
projects.description: A native Android app exploring focused digital habits through configurable AI-app redirection to Lyra, short-video controls, and on-device family browsing filters.

projects.name: NEPHRA · Smart Water Bottle System
projects.company: Hardware · With Adwaith R Krishna US
projects.description: A smart water bottle system with ESP32, copper tape sensor, and MPU6050, featuring mobile app integration, hydration tracking, and cloud AI analytics.

projects.name: Personal website
projects.description: My personal portfolio, built with Next.js and TypeScript. Brings together projects, skills, and my journey with an interactive background and a responsive interface.

awards.title: AIBoomi Startup Weekend Kochi · 1st place
awards.description: Competed with Lyra as the youngest solo team in a 20-hour buildathon with 76 teams and around 140 participants. Won first place and received $10,000 in OpenAI API credits.

awards.title: HackTVM Access Point · 1st place
awards.description: With Chris V Jacob, shaped the first versions of Mitra and MNEMO in seven hours and finished first by points among the five teams advancing to Phase 2.

awards.title: SAMEEKSHA · 1st place
awards.description: Presented Lyra at SAMEEKSHA, part of SRISHTI at Saintgits College of Engineering, and won first place.

awards.title: Hackfinity · 1st place
awards.description: Shared Lyra at Hackfinity, organised by HowNWhy Education at St. John’s Central School, Anchal, and won first place.

awards.title: Hack4Future · 2nd place
awards.description: Took Lyra to my first hackathon in Kochi, won second place, and brought back new questions to work on.
